name: LDAP Identity Provider
author: McSparrow <hi@mcsparrow.dev>
description: LDAP / Active Directory identity provider. Plug the bind credentials into McHarbor's login form; the plugin binds, searches for the user, optionally looks up group memberships, and provisions a session. Required fields: server_url (ldap:// or ldaps://), base_dn, bind_dn, bind_password, user_filter; optional group_search_base, group_filter, use_tls, skip_tls_verify. Works with OpenLDAP, 389-DS, FreeIPA, Active Directory. Tile shows up in Settings > Security > Identity Providers as 'LDAP'.
